name: memory-digest-cli
description: A CLI tool to generate digests from dated YYYY-MM-DD.md memory files, extracting events, decisions, and insights into a summary
//test:coverage: Coverage runs under c8, not node's --experimental-test-coverage. Since tsx 4.23 the `tsx --test` CLI adds --enable-source-maps, so node maps coverage back to the .ts sources. tsx wraps every CJS module in `__filename=...;(()=>{ ... })()` on a generated line that has no source-map entry, node drops that unmappable first range of the wrapper, and what is left is the wrapper's trailing `0&&(module.exports={...})` block with count 0: one phantom uncovered `anonymous_0` function per module (functions 100.00 -> 82.93 with identical code and tests). Up to tsx 4.22 the maps were not applied, so node measured the transpiled JS instead (lines were generated lines, functions included esbuild helpers). c8 (v8-to-istanbul) maps the same V8 data to the sources without the phantom, so lines are real source lines again; esbuild helper functions (__name, __export, ...) are still counted, as covered functions on source line 1. Thresholds are unchanged.
